title: Part Nineteen: The Verdict on the Front Hypothesis

sections.brief: The five tests fixed in vt1_front_test (private record; money and favours; timing of shifts; treaty behaviour; cost of opposition) plus the after-recognition prediction, each scored against Parts 2–18 with no new evidence; Herzl's grave 2014 weighed. Figures: fig-compare (test | front predicts | record shows | verdict)

The volume's answer: the refusal was real policy, not a front; graded settled / probable / not established; Zionism and Israel kept apart from Jews and Judaism; the other question groups in brief; labelled interpretation passage on the five lenses (IOR = ROI, VaticanOS, Babylon to Rome, loud silence, unprovable product). Figures: fig-compare (question | settled | contested)

Open questions as of October 2026 and what would settle them: Pius XII files on Palestine 1945–58 and Rioli; 1958–93 papers closed; Sneh–Tardini 1947; the 1944 note; Becciu after 29 October 2026; Orlandi commission; ICI recovery; Holy See–Israel economic agreement; Leo XIV's next steps. Figures: fig-time (dates to watch), fig-compare (status | what would settle it)
